name: vcredist-installed
label: Visual C++ Runtime
description: The Microsoft Visual C++ 2015+ x64 Runtime is installed (MSVCP140.dll and VCRUNTIME140_1.dll in System32).

commands.win32: $env:Path += ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','Machine') + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User') + ';' + $env:LOCALAPPDATA + '\Microsoft\WindowsApps'; winget install --id Microsoft.VCRedist.2015+.x64 -e --source winget --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements --disable-interactivity; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { winget install --id Microsoft.VCRedist.2015+.x64 -e --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements --disable-interactivity }

exe_data.prompt: Install the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable for Visual Studio 2015-2022 (x64) on this machine, from https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe.
